name: PDF Cover Cards
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
You can now browse pages on drawn PDF cards.
Preserves literal percent signs in vault paths.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Use Previous page and Next page on a card to preview other pages of its PDF.
PDF links with spaces, parentheses, accents or a percent sign now find the right file.
tip: Add #page=N to a PDF link to show another page as the card cover.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. PDF Cover Cards is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
